    33  @[expose] public section

    35  open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
    36  
    37  namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    38  
    39  universe u
    40  
    41  /--
    42  A valuative commutative square over a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is a square
    43  ```
    44  Spec K ⟶ Y
    45    |       |
    46    ↓       ↓
    47  Spec R ⟶ X
    48  ```
    49  where `R` is a valuation ring, and `K` is its ring of fractions.
    50  
    51  We are interested in finding lifts `Spec R ⟶ Y` of this diagram.
    52  -/
    53  structure ValuativeCommSq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) where
    54    /-- The valuation ring of a valuative commutative square. -/
    55    R : Type u
    56    [commRing : CommRing R]
    57    [domain : IsDomain R]
    58    [valuationRing : ValuationRing R]
    59    /-- The field of fractions of a valuative commutative square. -/
    60    K : Type u
    61    [field : Field K]
    62    [algebra : Algebra R K]
    63    [isFractionRing : IsFractionRing R K]
    64    /-- The top map in a valuative commutative map. -/
    65    (i₁ : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X)
    66    /-- The bottom map in a valuative commutative map. -/
    67    (i₂ : Spec (.of R) ⟶ Y)
    68    (commSq : CommSq i₁ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) f i₂)
    69  
    70  namespace ValuativeCommSq
    71  
    72  attribute [instance] commRing domain valuationRing field algebra isFractionRing
    73  
    74  end ValuativeCommSq
    75  
    76  /-- A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` satisfies the existence part of the valuative criterion if
    77  every valuative commutative square over `f` has (at least) a lift. -/
    78  def ValuativeCriterion.Existence : MorphismProperty Scheme :=
    79    fun _ _ f ↦ ∀ S : ValuativeCommSq f, S.commSq.HasLift
    80  
    81  /-- A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` satisfies the uniqueness part of the valuative criterion if
    82  every valuative commutative square over `f` has at most one lift. -/
    83  def ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness : MorphismProperty Scheme :=
    84    fun _ _ f ↦ ∀ S : ValuativeCommSq f, Subsingleton S.commSq.LiftStruct
    85  
    86  /-- A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` satisfies the valuative criterion if
    87  every valuative commutative square over `f` has a unique lift. -/
    88  def ValuativeCriterion : MorphismProperty Scheme :=
    89    fun _ _ f ↦ ∀ S : ValuativeCommSq f, Nonempty (Unique (S.commSq.LiftStruct))
    90  
    91  variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    92  
    93  lemma ValuativeCriterion.iff {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    94      ValuativeCriterion f ↔ Existence f ∧ Uniqueness f := by
    95    change (∀ _, _) ↔ (∀ _, _) ∧ (∀ _, _)
    96    simp_rw [← forall_and, unique_iff_subsingleton_and_nonempty, and_comm, CommSq.HasLift.iff]

    99      ValuativeCriterion = Existence ⊓ Uniqueness := by
